description: SDK 2.0 response compatibility only. The canonical public schema remains unchanged.

is_one_time.title: One-Time Purchase
is_one_time.description: Indicates whether this invoice is for a one-time purchase. Default is False, meaning it is a recurring invoice.

is_payout.title: Payout
is_payout.description: Indicates whether this invoice is a payout to the marketer. Default is False.

internal_id.description: A unique identifier for the invoice, generated automatically.

status.description: After changing invoice status to PAID, the invoice will be processed and user package created in case none exists. If you need to cancel the invoice, make sure to subtract data from the user package after changing the invoice status. Changing the status from PAID to any other will not affect the user package's data or proxies. * `pending` - Pending * `paid` - Paid * `unpaid` - Unpaid * `error` - Error

description.description: A description of the invoice. This field is optional and can be left blank.

connection_limit.description: The maximum number of concurrent connections allowed for this package.

data.title: Data (bytes)
data.description: The amount of data in bytes.

balance.title: Balance Top Up (cents)
balance.description: The balance to top up for the user. Must be zero or positive.

price_total.title: Price (cents)
price_total.description: The total price of the invoice, including any discounts. Must be at least 1 cent.

gateway.title: Payment Gateway
gateway.description: The payment gateway used for processing the payment. * `coinbase` - Coinbase * `cryptomus` - Cryptomus * `stripe` - Stripe * `coingate` - Coingate * `wallet` - Wallet * `manual` - Manual * `whitepay` - Whitepay * `wayforpay` - WayForPay * `usegateway` - UseGateway * `binance` - Binance Pay * `anymoney` - Any.Money * `coinpayments` - CoinPayments * `checkoutcom` - Checkout.com * `nowpayments` - NOWPayments * `btcpay` - BTCPay Server * `braintree` - Braintree * `monobank` - monobank * `liqpay` - LiqPay * `iyzico` - iyzico * `paytr` - PayTR * `payu` - PayU * `tpay` - Tpay * `przelewy24` - Przelewy24 * `gopay` - GoPay * `comgate` - Comgate * `monei` - MONEI * `redsys` - Redsys * `payplug` - PayPlug * `mollie` - Mollie * `unzer` - Unzer * `payone` - PAYONE * `nexi_xpay` - Nexi XPay * `halyk_epay` - Halyk ePay * `kaspi_pay` - Kaspi Pay * `vipps_mobilepay` - Vipps MobilePay * `paytrail` - Paytrail

currency.title: Billing Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency captured when the invoice is created.

provider_checkout_id.description: Provider-side hosted checkout identifier used for reconciliation.

provider_payment_id.description: Provider-side payment or transaction identifier used for reconciliation.

vat.title: VAT (%)
vat.description: The VAT percentage applied to the invoice. Must be between 0 and 100.

paid.description: The date and time when the invoice was paid.

expires.description: The date and time when the invoice expires. If not set, the invoice does not expire.

InvoiceRead.description: Full invoice in package-based deployments; short invoice otherwise. Invoice creation always returns the full Invoice representation.

User.description: Customer account with contact details, security settings, package data, referral information, and managed sub-users visible to the caller.

username.description: Value must contain only letters, numbers, and underscores. It must not start or end with an underscore.

is_reseller.title: Reseller
is_reseller.description: Reseller can create sub-users and manage their data.

is_marketer.title: Marketer
is_marketer.description: Marketer can manage marketing campaigns and view analytics.

is_superuser.title: Superuser status
is_superuser.description: Designates that this user has all permissions without explicitly assigning them.

date_joined_ts.description: Timestamp of when the user joined

allowed_ips.description: List of IP addresses allowed for this user

blocked_domains.description: List of domains blocked for this user

connection_limit.description: The maximum number of concurrent connections allowed for this package.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent user (for sub-accounts)

sub_users.description: Number of sub-users managed by this reseller

referrals.description: Number of users referred by this user

currency.description: Currency information for the user's transactions

data.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

data_spent.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

data_updated.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

proxy_password.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

proxy_password_reset.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is disabled.

orders.description: Present only when SITE_PACKAGE_BASED_AUTH is enabled.

package_id.description: Package whose proxy password should be rotated. Required only when package-based authentication is enabled.
